name: Anchovy [boquerón; bocarte]
definition: Raw anchovy of the genus Engraulis, sold whole, chilled or frozen; fry sold as whitebait is J2.1.1.53, marinated J2.4.06, tinned J2.4.05.
notes: Marx Foods sells wild whole head-on Spanish anchovies, individually quick frozen; no species named

name: Cuttlefish [sepia; seiche]
definition: Raw cuttlefish of the genus Sepia, sold whole or cleaned, chilled or frozen; dried cuttlefish is J2.3.14, squid J2.1.3.04.
notes: J.J. McDonnell lists fresh and frozen cuttlefish whole, cleaned, fillets; Greendale sells frozen cleaned cuttlefish
